subject: Pipeline rationalization: Q2 QBR pack & commit updates
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com

Subject: Pipeline rationalization: Q2 QBR pack & commit updates
Attachments: Q2_QBR_template.xlsx (xlsx), pipeline_export.csv (csv)

Team —

As we lock Q2 numbers for the leadership QBR, I need a concise, cleaned-up pack that shows:
- Confirmed commits (by owner) for any deals > $50k
- Deals we can decommit this quarter (stale >90 days)
- Stage hygiene action items (who will reach out and by when)

Please do the following by EOD Monday (29 Jun):
1) Update your pipeline stages in CRM to reflect current legal/procurement status.
2) Mark any $0 or unlikely commits as "At Risk / Remove" and add a one-line rationale.
3) Use the attached Q2_QBR_template.xlsx and export the pipeline CSV (pipeline_export.csv) and drop both in the Drive link below.

I will compile a one-page summary for execs and circulate the pack on Thurs 1 Jul. If you have outstanding procurement blockers (contracts, SOC evidence) call them out in your updates so we can surface to Rev Ops.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBRtemplateshare
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/8421

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

—Marissa

- Includes confirmed commits >$50k (see page 2). RDW-8421 remains as "Commit - pending PO" (owner: Marissa). Jenna confirmed earlier that Acme expects PO next week; we will keep as commit but annotate as procurement risk.
- Removed 4 stale deals; those are on the "At Risk / Remove" tab with one-line rationales.
- Aditya's uplift adjustments are in the cover note.

Deliverables — please final check by EOD tomorrow (2 Jul):
- Marissa: final commit confirmation and one-line rationale for removed deals.
- Lauren: confirm any region-level changes (if you think we should reassign any late-stage deals).
- Aditya: export final pipeline CSV and confirm HubSpot deal pipeline statuses are synced.

I'll upload the final QBR pack to the Drive and send to execs Friday morning.
